name: @hellboy/app
description: Hellboy Studio - a desktop app for Hellboy Prod, no terminal needed.

scripts.build: npm run embed && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run bundle
scripts.bundle: npm run embed && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --loader:.html=text --outfile=build/app.cjs && esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --loader:.html=text --outfile=build/cli.cjs
